Statistics_Mod.Title: Session Statistics
Statistics_Mod.Line_Play_Time_Average: Play time: {~Gold}@time@ min{~} | Avg. turn: {~Gold}@average@ min{~}
Statistics_Mod.Line_Player_Activity_Summary: Player totals: spells {~MediumPurple}@combat@ combat{~} / {~Green}@map@ map{~} | distance {~Green}@distance@{~}
Statistics_Mod.Line_Average_Magic_Damage: Average spell damage per combat cast: {~MediumPurple}@value@{~}
Statistics_Mod.Line_Creatures_Recruited: Recruited: {~Gold}@towns@ in towns{~} | {~Gold}@dwellings@ in external dwellings{~}
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Table_Title: Statistics collected since the beginning of the current map.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Portrait: The selected hero whose personal statistics are currently displayed.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Name: The selected hero. Use the arrow buttons to view another owned hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Combat_Category: Combat performance of the selected hero and the hero's army.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Magic_Category: Spells, spell damage, and spell points used by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Exploration_Category: Movement, adventure-map objects, and special challenges completed by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Realm_Category: Player-wide totals recorded on the current map.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Fights: Completed combats for this hero; discarded battle replays are excluded.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Fights_Defeated: Completed combats and defeated enemy heroes for the selected hero; discarded battle replays are excluded.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Kills: Enemy creatures killed by the selected hero's army and spells.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Physical_Damage: Actual physical damage dealt, separated into melee attacks and ranged shots; overkill is limited where possible.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Total_Damage: Combined physical army damage and direct damage from the hero's spells.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Lost_Units: Units permanently missing from the hero's seven army stacks after completed battles.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Commander_Damage: Direct melee, ranged, and spell damage caused by the selected hero's WoG or ACM commander.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Battle_Replays: Number of completed battle results discarded by replaying the battle with this hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Heroes_Defeated: Number of enemy heroes defeated by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Max_Physical_Hit: Highest recorded damage from a single melee or ranged attack.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Magic_Damage: Total direct damage caused by spells cast by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Max_Magic_Hit: Highest recorded direct damage from a single hero spell.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Average_Magic_Damage: Direct spell damage divided by all combat spells, including support spells.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Combat_Spells: Number of spells cast by the selected hero during combat.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Adventure_Spells: Number of spells cast by the selected hero on the adventure map.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_All_Spells: Combined combat and adventure-map spells cast by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Hero_Spells: Combat and adventure-map spells cast by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Commander_Casts: Spells cast by the selected hero's WoG or ACM commander during combat.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Spell_Upgrades: Actual ACM spell upgrades gained by the selected hero during combat.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Mana_Spent: Total spell points spent by the selected hero during combat.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Distance_Land_Sea: Tiles travelled by the selected hero, separated into land and sea.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Map_Objects: All object visits and the subset that can improve primary statistics.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Treasure_Chests: Number of normal treasure chests collected by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Artifacts_Collected: Number of adventure-map artifacts collected by the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Resource_Piles: Resource piles collected; their contained amounts do not matter.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Towns_Visited: Town visits by the selected hero; repeated visits count again.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Mines_Visited: Mine visits by the selected hero; repeated visits count again.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Towns_Mines_Visited: Town and mine visits by the selected hero; repeated visits count again.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Chambers_Cleared: Creature-bank chambers cleared by the selected hero, read from the Advanced Classes Mod.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Exploration_Victories: Creature-bank chambers, Arena victories, Raid Boss victories, and Battle Commander victories recorded for the selected hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Game_Day: Current day of the running map.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Play_Time_Average: Active play time and average duration of completed player turns.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Economy: Recorded gold income, gold expenses, and other resources collected.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Player_Combat: Completed fights and enemy heroes defeated by all heroes of this player; discarded battle replays are excluded.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Player_Activity: Combat spells, map spells, and distance summed across all player heroes.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Player_Conquests: Towns and mines captured after an actual owner change.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Creatures_Recruited: Creatures recruited from town dwellings and external adventure-map dwellings.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Special_Victories: Arena, Raid Boss, and Battle Commander victories from compatible mods.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Previous_Hero: Show statistics for the previous hero.
Statistics_Mod.Hint_Next_Hero: Show statistics for the next hero.
